keySentence: Toad got in trouble because of his habits.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Toad took someone else's car. The police caught him again. He went to prison. Toad got in trouble because of his habits.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Toad could not resist when he saw a beautiful new car. He took it without asking and drove it away fast. The police chased him and caught him right away. Toad got in trouble because of his habits and bad choices. This time the punishment was very serious indeed. Poor Toad was sent to prison for a very long time.
